integrity: All four finite computations and complete directed-face-poset acyclicity checks were independently reconstructed from the embedded standard-library verifier, which also checks every symmetry character against invariant square triples.
scientific_limitations: Rational equivariant homology for the four finite grids only; no integral equivariant lattice, geometric basis, equivariant homotopy type, or infinite-family conclusion. Nonequivariant sphere multiplicities are established elsewhere and are not claimed as new.
title: Planar-orientation-twisted three-square characters of fourth robust grid complexes through sixteen vertices
